pack.provenance: Fictional development pack. Every record below is invented to exercise the Haunt Pack path end to end; none of it describes a real event.
pack.notes: A haunt the application has no code for: its own vocabulary (Trail), its own venues, and a kind of experience — a show — that neither shipped haunt has.

haunt.name: Moonlight Fright Festival
haunt.description: A fictional autumn festival held over three weekends in a working orchard. Its walk-throughs are called Trails, it runs a single scare zone through the parking meadow, and it closes each night with a stage show.
haunt.tagline: A fictional festival in an orchard, three weekends every October.

experienceTypes.description: A walk-through route through the orchard.

experiences.name: Hollow Road
experiences.summary: A lantern-lit walk along the orchard's oldest track.

wiki.overview: Hollow Road runs the length of the orchard's original cart track, lit by lanterns hung in the trees.
wiki.experience: Roughly eight minutes on foot, entirely outdoors, with the scares worked into the rows of trees rather than into built sets.

characters.name: The Orchardist
characters.description: The figure who walks the rows with a lantern.

wiki.story: The festival's programme frames the shed as still working, and still owed.

related.notes: Both are presented as part of the orchard's own story.
